text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking by the training
track, a
conversation between two
Umamusume in the
distance catches my
attention.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's enough. Training any more would
be
pointless.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
No, it wouldn't! Why would you say
that?! If I
don't train more, I'll—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You would continue pushing yourself,
even if it
means injuring your leg?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Cast aside the panic you're feeling
toward your
upcoming debut and have
your leg properly
examined.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You can think about training after that.
If you
need advice then, I would be glad
to provide
some.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Air Groove... Thank you so much.

Her fury quelled, the younger
Umamusume bows
to Air Groove before
leaving.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. It is my given duty as the Empress
to lead
the others. I'm not here to put on
a show.

may

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Each Umamusume has dreams she will
never give
up on... and aspects of herself
she won't
compromise on.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Observing these two points carefully is
the first
step to guiding them.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
One must be flexible and adapt. I
wouldn't be the
Empress otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We're done here. You'd best return to
your own
tasks.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You fool. Do you know who you're
talking to?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As the Empress, how do you think I
would be able
to guide others if I didn't
devote my earnest
attention to each
individual?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I won't stand for such insolence next
time. Watch
yourself and consider the
person you're speaking
to before you
open your mouth.
